postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU Universal DataBase Sep. 2025 no-postcode list, in the file updated 20 August 2026, includes Botswana. The UPU Botswana sheet and current BotswanaPost page use P.O. Box or private bag plus locality without a postcode. A P.O. box, private bag, plot, street, district, ward, village, locality, route, telephone number, AGID value or synthetic planning code is not a Botswana postcode.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current postcode assignments exist to anchor postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Country, district, ward, village, locality, post-office, route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, plot, street or physical address, P.O.-box-or-private-bag object, locality and country as separate fields. Do not insert a fabricated postcode into domestic addresses.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: A P.O. box number or private-bag identifier is a delivery object, not a postcode or postal area.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires separately rights-cleared civic-address identity and an explicit reviewed relation to point or footprint geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may return independently typed address context only under source-specific rights; they must never manufacture a postcode or postal surface.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. BW planning cells and search-result IDs are not BotswanaPost assignments or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Reviewed BotswanaPost, Botswana Government and UPU pages are reference evidence. Website copyright and UPU copyright/database restrictions do not grant AGID processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights for a postal dataset.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO BW identity and Botswana's territory; do not borrow codes or geometry from another jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, box or bag holders, customer addresses, parcel observations, telephone numbers, coordinates, buildings and query logs remain excluded absent explicit authority and minimisation.
postal_system.temporal_rule: No-postcode status is time-dependent; preserve retrieval time, edition, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check after the pending-country sweep or an official announcement.

stages.definition: Botswana address-format inventory with an unsupported alpha-2 plus three-digit postcode assumption.
Digest-bound BotswanaPost, Botswana Government and UPU evidence that Botswana currently does not require postal codes, plus rights, address format, delivery-object and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative BotswanaPost or competent public release establishing a Botswana postcode system and a complete finite denominator of every assignment, P.O.-box/private-bag distinction, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Current UPU evidence says Botswana does not require postcodes; absence is represented as none and does not satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon milestone. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Country, district, ward, village, locality, address, post office, P.O. box, private bag, plot, street, route, service area, building, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID cell and synthetic BW planning code are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real BW API/app, handling no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, failure and invalid geometry states, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, clear/re-search, and display of code, geometry kind, class, source, date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: BW metadata, no-postcode policy, current P.O.-box/private-bag and civic-address field semantics only; no real BW Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual BW loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a Botswana postal polygon. Independently licensed address or administrative context remains typed and source-qualified.
